briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push multi-agent frontier amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensified this week with new frontier releases from OpenAI and xAI. Funding surged past $11B quarterly while safety concerns around multi-agent systems grew. Dynamic dialect negotiation protocols are gaining traction in enterprise deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration. xAI launched Grok-4 claiming superior reasoning benchmarks. DeepSeek and Meta both shipped incremental updates. Anthropic's Claude 4.1 remains in testing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with early automotive and IoT pilots showing strong results.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping. Google and Microsoft both broke ground on new 100k GPU clusters. Energy constraints are now the primary bottleneck for next-gen training runs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems reach reliable superhuman performance before 2028 safety standards are finalized?
